metaTitle: Toni's Sushi Bar Social Media Case Study | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Button Up Media films chef-led short videos for Toni's Sushi Bar, a family-run South Beach sushi spot since 1987, for Instagram and beyond in Miami Beach.
ldHeadline: Toni's Sushi Bar: chef-led social media videos for a South Beach sushi bar
h1Sub: Chef-led short videos on South Beach
answer: Toni's Sushi Bar has been family-run on South Beach since 1987. We made its sushi chef the on-camera star of short videos built for Instagram.
timeframeReviewNote: confirm the month Toni's started with us.

paragraphs: Toni's has been family-run on South Beach since 1987, when Hiromi “Toni” Takarada opened it, according to Miami New Times.
A spot with that much history already has the food and the story. The work is getting both in front of people who now pick where to eat by scrolling short videos.

items.title: Make the sushi chef the star
items.bodyHtml: He is the on-camera personality, so every video feels like a seat at the bar.

items.title: Shoot the close-ups that make people hungry
items.bodyHtml: Knife work and nigiri, filmed up close.

items.title: Write hooks the way people scroll
items.bodyHtml: Openers like “POV: you find the best sushi spot on South Beach” give people a reason to stop and watch.
